shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the marker at (2, 8) in the left image with the marker at 0.5 on the number line in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The plotted segment excludes its left endpoint (2, 8). Right image: The interval includes the lower boundary 0.5.
Rationales: The selected left cue excludes the indicated boundary point. The selected right cue includes the indicated boundary point, so the two constraints differ in how they admit values.
